messages:
Emily C: FYI Riverbend Ops asked to add Analytics + Data Science teams next month. They expect nightly batch inference to jump ~4x and want options for predictable latency. Asking about Dedicated vs burst capacity. cc @Priya S for renewal impact :eyes:
Diego R: Do we have their query distribution? spikes per minute vs sustained qps?
Emily C: Short summary from customer:
- nightly window 01:00-04:00 UTC, 600k tokens/hr (current) -> projected 2.4M tokens/hr
- steady daytime 10-30 qps
- some long-context eval jobs (up to 8k tokens)
Diego R: OK that pattern favors burstable dedicated pools or scheduled reserved capacity. Any SLA/latency targets from them?
Emily C: They said <150ms 95th for short generations, but long jobs can be best-effort. Renewal conversation in May, they're evaluating cost if this gets worse.
Priya S: Renewal risk noted — if analytics team sees throttling cost surprise they may pause. Need clear plan + cost estimate.
Alex M: We should propose two options: 1) small Dedicated pod for nightly window + autoscale policy to scale down; 2) keep hosted + use scheduled throughput boost (burst commits) and KV caching on prefixes. I'll rough cost numbers.
Marta L: Can we run a 2-week canary with their production prompt set to validate perf? Also enable request-level tracing so we can show latency breakdown in Console.
Emily C: They can share prompt set, yes. Riverbend asked for a short enablement session for both teams next Wed.
autoscale-bot: autoscaler alert: predicted capacity breach for riverbend-prod on 2024-04-12 01:00 UTC if no capacity change (+18%).
Diego R: Emily, drop me their sample prompt set and representative curl usage. I'll run locally against a staging replica to estimate latency and memory footprint.
Emily C: Pasted sample usage from customer:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"Summarize 20k token doc","max_tokens":2000}'
```
Priya S: Also asking for a single invoice line for the analytics teams usage if Dedicated — helps their finance team. Add that to options.
Alex M: I'll prepare two proposals with TCO and perf graphs. Can we get a dateslot for the enablement Wed 10am PT?
Marta L: I can do the enablement and bring a product eng to go through tracing and canary steps.
Emily C: Great — I'll confirm with Riverbend and upload the prompt set to the secure share. Next action: Alex to send proposals by EOD Monday, Diego to run staging tests, Marta to prepare enablement deck.
Diego R: Noted. I'll post the staging perf findings back in this thread.
Priya S: I'll flag renewal team and include the finance ask in our renewal playbook.
Emily C: Thanks all :thumbsup: — keeping this open as expansion + renewal watch.
